title: Digital Economy and Regional Green Total Factor Productivity: China Provincial Data and Spatial-Econometric Materials
description: A research toolkit for empirical work on the relationship between China's digital economy and regional green total factor productivity. The repository assembles provincial panel indicators, green productivity measures, control variables, spatial-weight matrices, Markov-transition workbooks, Stata and MATLAB templates, and supporting data-processing materials. The README and linked data catalogue explain coverage, file organization, variable interpretation, software dependencies, and reproducibility limits. Many files are source or intermediate research materials rather than a single turnkey pipeline; users should document the exact workbook, script, sample period, and transformation used in each analysis.
